a9-compare-reroll.js: const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); await sleep(2500); const sel = document.querySelector('.content .selectbox'); const inp = sel?.querySelector('.mud-input'); inp?.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(900); const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mud-popover .mud-list-item')].filter(e => e.innerText.trim().startsWith('Run build 1')); items[items.length - 1]?.click(); await sleep(2000); [...document.querySelectorAll('.segmented button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === "The baseline's")?.click(); await sleep(2000);
